messages:
Alex Chen: quick sync — Console needs inputs for the new batching/queueing panels. focus: batch size distribution histogram, queue wait time (p50/p95), and queue fill-rate/saturation per pool. who from runtime/infra can share metric shapes and cardinality?
Maya Gupta: I can start with UI requirements. want a per-queue heatmap + histogram + sparkline for wait time. also a stacked bar for batch size buckets. small + mobile-friendly.
Samir Patel: runtime currently emits hdr histograms for batch size and wait time per worker_id + queue. we can either: export pre-bucketed histograms (low cardinality) or raw tdigest blobs (higher throughput/cost).
Jordan Lee: cardinality warning — per-worker tags blow up ingestion. prefer per-queue aggregated buckets with worker_id only for debug mode. estimate: moving hdr->per-queue buckets reduces series by ~90%.
Lia (oncall): For alerts we need a clear saturation signal: "queue_fill_rate > 0.85 for 5m" and "p95 wait > 300ms". also an emergency panel that highlights queues hitting quota headroom.
Prashant Rao: UX ask: during rollout can we default to aggregated view and let power users flip to detailed? also need a toggle in Rollouts UI to pin metric granularity so can test with canary models.
Samir Patel: proposal: runtime emits these metrics (low-cardinality):
```
redwood_batch_size_bucket{queue="api", le="1"}
redwood_batch_size_bucket{queue="api", le="2"}
redwood_batch_size_bucket{queue="api", le="4"}
redwood_batch_size_bucket{queue="api", le="8"}
redwood_batch_wait_seconds_bucket{queue="api", le="0.05"}
redwood_queue_fill_ratio{queue="api"}
```
We can keep worker_id as an optional label behind a feature flag.
Maya Gupta: UI can consume these Prom-style buckets directly. for the histogram we want percentile lines (p50/p95/p99) and a distribution overlay. heatmap should use fill_ratio with a gradient and small sparkline for trend.
Jordan Lee: ingestion impact: estimate 1200 series -> 15000 series if we include worker_id. agree with feature flag. also need TTL for debug-series (48h).
Lia (oncall): can we expose a composite saturation metric to simplify alerts, e.g. `queue_saturation = max(queue_fill_ratio, p95_wait_norm)` and then alert if > 0.8? less noisy for oncall.
Samir Patel: we can publish a `redwood_queue_saturation{queue=...}` derived metric from the runtime aggregator. implementation: local reducer every 30s. low cost.
Prashant Rao: Platform notes: Console panels need a small API contract. suggest telemetry v2 returns either: 
1) pre-aggregated Prom buckets (preferred)
2) tdigest blobs for client-side compute (opt-in)
Example telemetry payload (v2):
```
{
  "queue": "api",
  "interval_start": 1710000000,
  "batch_size_buckets": [0, 10, 25, 50, 100],
  "batch_size_counts": [1200, 3400, 2100, 600, 80],
  "wait_ms_p50": 12.2,
  "wait_ms_p95": 210.1,
  "fill_ratio": 0.67,
  "saturation": 0.67
}
```
(we'll keep this example in docs; telemetry service returns NDJSON for query windows)
Maya Gupta: good — UI can render that shape. we need a small sample dataset for design and e2e tests.
Alex Chen: action items: Samir to add `redwood_queue_saturation` and ensure per-queue buckets are exported behind flag by EOD+3. Jordan to add TTL and ingestion estimate to infra backlog. Prashant to draft the telemetry v2 contract and example payloads. Maya will mock UI panels and attach sample data. Lia will propose alert thresholds for SRE runbook.
Eva (telemetry-bot): telemetry service note: current API v1 returns raw worker histograms. v2 draft endpoint: `/v2/telemetry/queues?start=&end=&granularity=30s`. will add to internal changelog.
Samir Patel: quick code note for PromQL p95 wait: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_batch_wait_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, queue))` — if we use buckets that's straightforward.
Jordan Lee: verified — if buckets are per-queue only, that query is cheap. if worker dimension present, need `sum by (le, queue)`. good.
Prashant Rao: rollout UX: feature flag name `telemetry.v2.detail_mode`. default off. will include a console toggle and API param `detail=true`.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. I'll create the dashboard issue with mocks and link telemetry contract PR. ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
